===dependabot===
version: 2
registries:
  urbo-registry:
    type: maven-repository
    url: https://maven.pkg.github.com/sw-code/urbo-registry
    username: ""
    password: ${{ secrets.SWCODE_PACKAGES_READER }}

updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "gradle"
    directory: "/backend"
    schedule:
      interval: "daily"
    rebase-strategy: "auto"
    registries:
      - urbo-registry

  - package-ecosystem: "npm"
    directory: "/app"
    schedule:
      interval: "daily"
    rebase-strategy: "auto"

    groups:
      angular:
        patterns:
          - "@angular/*"
          - "rxjs"
          - "@angular-devkit/*"
          - "@schematics/angular"

observation.command: cd /workspace && grep -rn "urbo-registry\|pkg.github" . --include=*.kts --include=*.gradle --include=*.properties --include=*.toml --include=*.md --include=*.yml --include=*.yaml --include=*.json 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | grep -v sbom.cdx | head -20; echo "===dependabot==="; cat .github/dependabot.yml | head -30
